preprocessor_report.timestamp_interpretation: Source timestamps interpreted as UTC by explicit user assumption; verify with provider. This is NOT proof of live availability.
preprocessor_report.mobile_filter: Class A and Class B when mobile column exists; otherwise no mobile-type filter
preprocessor_report.availability_time: not supplied; no live-arrival time inferred
preprocessor_report.status: normalized data only; NOT a Cable Watch file and not validated for operational use

meta.availability: simulated: source timestamp is treated as available at the same time, not proven live latency
meta.dataset_type: real or synthetic according to input; user must verify provenance
